title: Domain AI Solutions

hero.headline: Selective domain systems where the fit is real.
hero.description: Applied systems for vertical use cases in energy, clinical validation, robotics, or other domains when the opportunity is justified.

problem: Some domains need specialized AI systems, but only when the problem, constraints, and evidence support it.
solution: Translate the research into a vertical system only when the use case is clear and commercially meaningful.
notFor: forcing every research topic into a product
proofNotes: This category should remain selective until there is a concrete opportunity and enough evidence to support a product claim.
